text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 5) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 11 Ogos 2026.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan kenderaan di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua,

melainkan di atas jalan arah yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama,

bagi tempoh yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3) Jadual Pertama, dilarang.

Pengecualian

3. Pengecualian daripada larangan itu hendaklah diberikan bagi maksud dan dalam

hal keadaan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

JADUAL PERTAMA

(1)

Jalan yang baginya

larangan terpakai

(2)

(3)

Sebahagian Laluan 8, Jalan Gua

Musang-Kota Bharu bermula

dari seksyen 348.10 hingga

seksyen 350.20 sebagaimana

yang ditunjukkan dalam peta

dalam Jadual Kedua

Kenderaan dari Kuala Krai

ke Kota Bharu dan

Tanah Merah dan sebaliknya

hendaklah menggunakan

jalan alternatif sebagaimana

yang ditunjukkan dalam peta

dalam Jadual Kedua

11 Ogos 2026 hingga

30 September 2026

JADUAL KEDUA

JADUAL KETIGA

PENGECUALIAN

1. Bagi maksud penyelenggaraan, pembaikan, peningkatan, pembersihan dan

pemugaran bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama.

2. Bagi maksud pemacakan, pemasangan, penyelenggaraan, pengubahan atau

pengalihan mana-mana struktur, kerja, peralatan atau apa-apa benda di dalam,

pada, di bawah atau di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama.

3. Bagi maksud perkhidmatan kecemasan dan penguatkuasaan oleh agensi Kerajaan

dan pihak berkuasa tempatan.

Dibuat 6 Ogos 2026

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.11; PN(PU2)460/JLD.143]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO.5) ORDER 2026

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 254/2026 published on 24 July 2026, notice was given of

the intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Minister of Works against the making

of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to in

subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use

of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 5) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 11 August 2026.

Prohibition

2. The driving of vehicles on the part of the road as specified in column (1)

of the First Schedule as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise

than on the routes specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, for the period specified

in column (3) of the First Schedule, is prohibited.

Exemption

3. Exemption from such prohibition shall be given for the purposes and

in circumstances specified in the Third Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

(1)

Road to which

prohibition applies

(2)

Routes

(3)

Part of Route 8, Gua MusangKota Bharu Road starting

from section 348.10 to

section 350.20 as shown on

the map in the Second Schedule

Vehicles from Kuala Krai to

Kota Bharu and Tanah Merah

and vice versa shall use

alternative road as shown on

the map in the Second Schedule

11 August 2026 to

30 September 2026

SECOND SCHEDULE

THIRD SCHEDULE

EXEMPTION

1. For the purposes of maintenance, repair, improvement, cleaning and clearance of

the part of road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

2. For the purposes of erection, installation, maintenance, alteration or removal of

any structure, works, apparatus or anything in, on, under or over the part of the

road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

3. For the purposes of emergency services and enforcement by the Government

agencies and local authorities.

Made 6 August 2026

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.11; PN(PU2)460/JLD.143]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI
